title: 12 Best Yoga & Ashram Retreats in Rishikesh
description: Discover the top 12 yoga and ashram retreats in Rishikesh for 2026. Find your ideal spiritual escape, from traditional ashrams to modern yoga schools, offering Hatha, Ashtanga, Ayurveda, and meditation experiences. Plan your mindful journey to the 'Yoga Capital of the World'.

places.name: Parmarth Niketan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Attend the daily Ganga Aarti ceremony at sunset; join a multi-day introductory yoga and meditation package.

places.name: Rishikesh Yogpeeth
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 200-hour Hatha Yoga Teacher Training (YTT) program for a comprehensive foundation.

places.name: Anand Prakash Yoga Ashram (Arsha Yoga Dham)
places.priceRange: INR 8,000-15,000 / USD $95-180 per night (for retreats, includes food & accommodation)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An Akhanda Yoga immersion retreat to experience their unique blend of practices.

places.name: Phool Chatti Ashram
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 7-day Yoga & Meditation Program for a deep dive into traditional ashram living.

places.name: Yoga Niketan Ashram
places.priceRange: INR 3,000-6,000 / USD $35-70 per night (room, meals, classes)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A week-long residential Hatha Yoga course for a structured and disciplined experience.

places.name: Ved Niketan Ashram
places.priceRange: INR 800-1,500 / USD $10-18 per night (basic room, some classes)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for a basic residential stay and attend their free daily yoga and meditation sessions.

places.name: Tattvaa Yoga Shala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 200-hour Ashtanga Vinyasa YTT for a deep dive into the practice.

places.name: Omkarananda Ganga Sadan (Sivananda Ashram)
places.priceRange: INR 2,500-4,000 / USD $30-50 per night (room, meals, classes)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enroll in their daily Sivananda Yoga and meditation classes, followed by philosophical discourses.

places.name: Himalayan Yoga Ashram
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 200-hour Multi-style Yoga Teacher Training for a diverse foundational education.

places.name: Swarg Ashram Trust
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Stay for a few nights to soak in the historical and spiritual ambiance, exploring the many temples and ghats along the Ganga.

places.name: Svadhyaya Yoga Ashram
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A weekend detox and meditation retreat for a refreshing and calming experience.

places.name: Aloha on the Ganges
places.priceRange: INR 15,000-30,000 / USD $180-360 per night (room only, packages extra)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A weekend wellness package which typically includes yoga sessions, meditation, and access to their spa facilities.
